name: Marina Coelho
bio: Marina is a Developer Relations Engineer at Google, focused on building native Android apps. Her mission is to help developers excel in building and growing their apps using Firebase, GCP and our suite of AI tools! Before joining the Firebase team in 2022, Marina worked as a software engineer for 8 years, 5 of which were dedicated to Android app development. She loves all things Jetpack Compose, Firebase and AI!
